muc.tieu_de: Drawing Qian (The Creative) when you ask about something: how to read it
muc.doan: Drawing Qian when you ask about something means the matter has real strength behind it, but each stage needs its own pace. The image is a dragon that rises step by step: hidden, then seen, then flying. It goes well when you act at the right time and stop before going too far.

muc.tieu_de: Examples of reading Qian (The Creative) in everyday life
danh_sach: Asking about a promotion soon after joining: build your track record first — the dragon is still hidden.
Asking whether to launch a project you have prepared for years: yes, this is the dragon appearing in the field.
Asking whether to push further after a big success: watch out for the 'arrogant dragon' — know when to stop.
